name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo’s passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Autódromo Juan y Oscar Gálvez with his grandfather, a former mechanic. While his family cheered on local Turismo Carretera legends, Mateo became fascinated not just by the roaring engines, but also the stories and personalities behind the teams. He pursued a degree in marketing, tailoring his studies to focus on the unique challenges and opportunities within the motorsport industry.

Eager to make his mark, Mateo believes in data-driven strategies combined with creative storytelling to build brand awareness and engage fans. He's particularly interested in leveraging social media and digital platforms to connect with a new generation of motorsport enthusiasts. His entry-level status fuels his ambition, and he is ready to learn and contribute to a team that values innovation and a strong connection to the sport's rich heritage.

Mateo's approach is collaborative; he thrives in environments where ideas are openly exchanged and where he can contribute his unique perspective as a young Argentine fan to bring fresh energy to any marketing initiative.

physical.hairStyle: short, slightly wavy, and neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable face.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with marketing ideas, sketches, and race notes.
Has a habit of pacing when brainstorming, often walking in circles while muttering to himself.
Insists on starting every meeting with a quick motorsport trivia question to get everyone engaged.
